question: Which state topped under the 'Major States' category in the second and latest edition of the India Innovation Index 2020?
solution:
The Correct Answer **Karnataka** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** India Innovation Index Report 2022:

__
 
• The report is released by NITI (National Institution for Transforming India) Ayog.
 
• The index has been developed on the lines of the Global Innovation Index (GII), to ameliorate the innovation ecosystem of Indian states and Union Territories (UTs) and to design policies to drive innovation across regions.
 
• The index goes beyond traditional approaches by considering the best parameters in measuring innovation such as patents per million of the population, publication in scientific journals, and percentage of GDP spending on research.
 
• It also adds parameters that are specific to the Indian economy (eg. Demographic dividend), to give it a more holistic coverage.
 
• The indicators that the survey uses include the level and quality of education and parameters such as:
 
 
• A number of Ph.D. students and knowledge-intensive employment.
 
• Enrolment in engineering and technology and a number of highly skilled professionals.
 
• Investment in R&D and a number of patents and trademark applications filed.
 
• Internet subscribers.
 
• FDI inflows, business environment and safety, and legal environment.
 
 
 
• The Innovation Index is divided into three categories—major states, Union Territories, and hill and North East states.

 [IMAGE: https://th-i.thgim.com/public/latest-news/14bjoz/article65668130.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/InnovationIndex.JPG] 

 
• Karnataka has topped again in the Major States category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Manipur is leading the North East and Hill States categories.
 
• Chandigarh is the top performer in the Union Territories and City States category.
 
• The third edition highlights the scope of innovation analysis in the country by drawing on the framework of the Global Innovation Index.
 
• The number of indicators has increased from 36 (in the India Innovation Index 2020) to 66 (in the India Innovation Index 2021).
 
• The indicators are now distributed across 16 sub-pillars, which, in turn, form seven key pillars.
